scope: Complete top-level entries of build, .audit and design/figma/research, plus root log/text/JSON files. Recursive static file counts exclude symlinks; named runtime/cache directories excluded. Markdown references searched outside build and archive. Existing archive separately inventoried by its manifests. Inventory captured after first four archived batches and before fifteen further batch moves; moved entries are marked archived. Penpot aggregate includes local runtime dependencies. Later review archived 426 individual historical .audit/logs traces and 12 older standalone build logs; see manifest for individual movements. Referenced .audit report files and other log types retained. Historical build scan was interrupted; static project text and audit report filenames were searched, and build doc-compaction references remain historical.
